groups.purpose: How much separation or inset a layout needs, smallest first; a gap or an inset is one step.
How rounded a box or a part is drawn, from none to full.
The typeface text is set in.

family.sans: The typeface of the interface's text.
family.mono: The typeface of code and of values read character by character.
family.heading: The typeface of headings; a theme may point it at a face of its own.

groups.purpose: What size text is set in, smallest first; text of the application's own takes its size from the `typography` family before this scale.
The line height that pairs with the font-size step of the same name.
The tracking large type takes: the tight step at the md and lg display steps, the tighter step at 3xl and 4xl. Text at the body steps reads the face as drawn.

tokens.--slotted-letter-spacing-tight: The tracking of a display figure or a wordmark at the md and lg font-size steps.
tokens.--slotted-letter-spacing-tighter: The tracking of a display figure at the 3xl and 4xl font-size steps.

groups.purpose: How much typographic emphasis text carries.

weight.medium: Text that stands out from running text without heading it.
weight.semibold: A heading, a control's label, a figure that leads.

groups.purpose: How thick an edge or a ring is drawn.

width.thin: The edge of a box, a control or a divider.
width.medium: The weight between thin and thick.

groups.purpose: How long a transition or one cycle of a loop takes. The steps from instant to long collapse under reduced motion; the loops do not, so a repeating animation stops there instead.

step.instant: A change that must not read as motion.
step.short: A control changing state: a ground, a border, a mark.
step.medium: A part appearing or leaving: a popover, a menu, a tooltip.
step.long: A surface entering or leaving over a larger distance: a drawer, a dialog.
step.loop-fast: One cycle of a fast repeating animation.
step.loop: One cycle of a repeating animation.
step.loop-slow: One cycle of a slow repeating animation.

groups.purpose: How the velocity of a transition changes.

curve.emphasized: A change meant to be noticed; it overshoots its end.

groups.purpose: Which layer an element occupies above the page.

layer.sticky: A header or a column that stays in place while its region scrolls.
layer.overlay: A modal surface and the scrim under it.
layer.popover: A popover, a menu or a tooltip; above an overlay, so one opens from a dialog.
layer.toast: A toast; above every other layer.

groups.purpose: What elevation a surface has above the one under it, smallest first; under forced colors every step is none.
The grounds content stands on.

tokens.--slotted-surface: The ground of the page's content and of a card.
tokens.--slotted-surface-raised: The ground of a surface above another: a popover, a menu, a dialog; paired with a step of `shadow`.
tokens.--slotted-surface-sunken: The canvas under the content: the ground a card and a field stand out from.
tokens.--slotted-surface-inverse: A ground in the opposite lightness, with `--slotted-text-inverse` on it.
tokens.--slotted-surface-inverse-hover: The inverse ground under the pointer: `--slotted-surface-inverse` moved a share toward the opposite lightness.
tokens.--slotted-surface-inverse-active: The inverse ground while pressed, a step beyond the hover.
tokens.--slotted-surface-material: The ground of a bar that floats over scrolling content, drawn as a material: `--slotted-surface` at a partial share over transparency, behind `--slotted-material-backdrop`. Under `prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce` it is `--slotted-surface`, and under forced colors the Canvas system color.
tokens.--slotted-material-backdrop: The backdrop filter a material is drawn with: the content scrolling under it, saturated and blurred. Each scheme states its own, because a light page holds less contrast for a blur to keep. Under `prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce` and forced colors it is `none`.

groups.purpose: The colors text is painted in.

tokens.--slotted-text-muted: Text that ranks below the text beside it: a caption, a hint, a secondary value.

groups.purpose: The colors of lines between and inside surfaces.

tokens.--slotted-border-subtle: A rule inside a surface: a divider, the edge of a region, the seam under a header.
tokens.--slotted-border-strong: The line between two surfaces; it holds 3:1 against every surface a control stands on.

groups.purpose: How an unavailable control is painted.

role.background: The ground of an unavailable control.
role.foreground: The text and icons of an unavailable control.
role.border: The edge of an unavailable control, a step lighter than the edge of an available one.

groups.purpose: The outline every focused element draws.

tokens.--slotted-focus-ring-width: The thickness of the focus outline.
tokens.--slotted-focus-ring-offset: The distance between the element and its focus outline.
tokens.--slotted-focus-ring-color: The color of the focus outline.
tokens.--slotted-focus-ring-color-invalid: The color of the focus outline of a control in error; an element in error points `--slotted-focus-ring-color` at it.

groups.purpose: How small an interactive target may be.

tokens.--slotted-target-min: The smallest target in both axes: 24 by 24 CSS pixels.
tokens.--slotted-target-comfortable: The size a target grows to under a coarse pointer.

groups.purpose: What an element carrying an intent is painted with: seven tones, each with the same nine roles.

tone.accent: The product's intent: the primary action, the chosen option, the current place.
tone.secondary: A second intent beside accent, for an action or a mark that must not compete with it.
tone.neutral: Ink: the inverse surface as a fill and the text color as a label, for a primary action in a product that keeps the accent for data.
tone.info: A fact the reader is told with no judgement of it: a note, a transfer, a change of state that is neither good nor bad. Its own seed, so it stays apart from an accent that shares a hue with success.
tone.success: A result that completed or a state that is healthy.
tone.warning: A state that needs attention before it becomes a failure.
tone.danger: A failure, an error or an action that destroys data.

role.solid: A filled ground: the primary button of the tone.
role.solid-hover: The filled ground under the pointer.
role.on-solid: Text and icons on the filled ground.
role.surface: A tinted ground; a state that must be seen pairs it with the tone's border.
role.subtle-hover: The tint under the pointer of an element with no filled ground.
role.border: An edge in the tone, at the non-text contrast ratio against the page and against its own surface.
role.text: Text in the tone on a surface.

groups.purpose: What a series of data is painted with: a line, a bar, a slice. Slots are assigned in order and never skipped.
The ink drawn on a data slot used as a ground — an icon on a category tile — at the non-text ratio (3:1, WCAG 1.4.11) against its slot in every scheme.
What a control's text and frame look like at every size.

tokens.--slotted-control-font-family: The typeface of a control's text.
tokens.--slotted-control-font-weight: The weight of a control's label.
tokens.--slotted-control-line-height: The line height of a control's text.
tokens.--slotted-control-letter-spacing: The letter spacing of a control's text.
tokens.--slotted-control-border-width: The edge width of a control at rest.
tokens.--slotted-control-shadow-focus-geometry: Offset, blur and spread of the shadow a focused control draws, with no color; drawn with `--slotted-focus-ring-color`.
tokens.--slotted-control-focus-ring-offset: The distance between a field's frame and its focus outline; set to the negative of `--slotted-control-border-width`, a field's ring lies flush over its border while a button keeps `--slotted-focus-ring-offset`.
tokens.--slotted-control-transition-duration: How long a control takes to change state.
tokens.--slotted-control-transition-easing: The curve of a control's change of state.
tokens.--slotted-control-invalid-edge-width: The edge an invalid control adds inside its border, so the state reads where color cannot.
tokens.--slotted-control-border-color: The edge color of a control at rest.
tokens.--slotted-control-surface: The ground of a control at rest: a field, a select, a segmented control.
tokens.--slotted-control-shadow: The shadow of a control at rest.

groups.purpose: The size and inner spacing of a control at each size step; every value follows density.

part.height: The block size of the control.
part.padding-inline: The inline space between the control's edge and its content.
part.font-size: The size of the control's text.
part.icon-size: The size of an icon inside the control.
part.gap: The space between items inside the control, and between one choice and the next in a group.
part.label-gap: The space between a binary control — a box, a circle, a switch — and its own label.
part.inner-size: The block size of what stands inside the control: a key, a chip, a clear mark.

groups.purpose: The size of a selection control and of the halo behind it.

tokens.--slotted-selection-size-sm: The box of a checkbox and the circle of a radio at the small step.
tokens.--slotted-selection-size-md: The box and the circle at the medium step.
tokens.--slotted-selection-size-lg: The box and the circle at the large step.
tokens.--slotted-selection-halo-opacity: The share of `--slotted-tone-accent-text` in the halo behind a selection control under the pointer.

groups.purpose: How strong the band behind a matched span is.

tokens.--slotted-highlight-tint-opacity: The share of `--slotted-tone-accent-text` in the band behind a matched span.

groups.purpose: How the place the reader is on is marked.

tokens.--slotted-current-edge: The edge of the row the reader is on, drawn over its tone ground.

groups.purpose: Translucent layers laid over whatever surface an element stands on, so a hovered, pressed or selected row reads the same on the page and on a raised surface. Each is the scheme's text color at a small share over transparency. Under forced colors every layer is the Canvas system color: the state is carried by the system colors the family draws, Highlight for selection and an outline for focus.

tokens.--slotted-state-pressed: The layer while the element is pressed; the strongest of the three.
tokens.--slotted-state-selected: The layer of a selected or open element, between hover and pressed.

groups.purpose: The veil under a modal surface.

tokens.--slotted-scrim: The veil between the page and a modal surface above it.

groups.purpose: The geometry of an icon a family draws itself; an icon of the application's own is drawn with the `icon` family.
The tile colors of file kinds in `upload` and `attachment`.
The colors of syntax scopes in `code-block`.
The edge of a star in `rating`.
The sizes of `avatar`, smallest first.

tokens.name: --slotted-font-family-heading
tokens.literal: a heading face may be a typeface of its own, which no primitive face names

tokens.name: --slotted-control-line-height
tokens.literal: a control sets its own line box to its height

tokens.name: --slotted-control-letter-spacing
tokens.literal: zero is the absence of tracking, not a scale step

tokens.name: --slotted-material-backdrop
tokens.literal: a filter function names no other token
